name: Biomni
description: General-purpose biomedical research agent that plans and executes analyses using a large set of bioinformatics tools and databases.
whatItDoes: Takes biomedical research tasks such as designing a screen, annotating single-cell data or predicting compound properties and carries them out end to end. It targets life-science researchers.
howItWorks: An LLM planner retrieves relevant tools, software and data from a prepared environment and writes code that it executes to complete the task. It is used as a Python library inside a dedicated conda environment, with a data lake downloaded on first use.

requirements.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
requirements.description: Alternative provider; Gemini, Groq, Bedrock and custom endpoints are also supported

requirements.name: Conda environment
requirements.description: biomni_e1 environment built by the setup script in biomni_env

models: Anthropic by default; OpenAI, Gemini, Groq, Bedrock, custom endpoints
